title: delivery-subject.v1
description: Canonical delivery subject produced by the subject projector. Binds product tree, spec identity, evidence policy, exclusions, lineage, and acceptance fingerprint. Task-projection revision and hash are execution provenance only and cannot alter the acceptance fingerprint. Unknown major versions block readiness.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. A reader that does not recognise this value must refuse rather than degrade.

subject_id.description: Stable identity for this delivery subject.

acceptance_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint over product, spec, evidence policy, exclusions, and lineage. Task-only changes do not alter this value.

product.description: Product tree references. The approval record retains the immutable base manifest.

spec.description: Spec identity. Spec enters acceptance identity; changes to spec change the acceptance fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the accepted spec artifact.

evidence_policy_ref.description: Reference to the evidence policy that governs this subject.

exclusions.description: Paths excluded from the delivery subject. Spec, plan, delivery-control, and approved mechanical paths are excluded.

lineage.description: Provenance of this delivery subject projection.

projection_version.description: Version of the projector that produced this subject.

task_projection_revision.description: Optional execution provenance: working-plan revision at projection time. Does not affect acceptance identity.

task_projection_hash.description: Optional execution provenance: working-plan content hash at projection time. Does not affect acceptance identity.
